# iosxe_voice_register_pool (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Register Pool configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_register_pool" "example" {
  tag = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) voice register pool commands

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `call_forward_b2bua_all` (String) forward all calls
- `call_forward_b2bua_busy` (String) forward call on busy
- `call_forward_b2bua_mailbox` (String) mailbox number
- `call_forward_b2bua_noan` (String) forward call on no-answer
- `call_forward_b2bua_noan_timeout` (Number) Ringing no answer timeout duration
- `cor_incoming` (Attributes List) incoming class of restriction list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cor_incoming))
- `cor_outgoing` (Attributes List) outgoing class of restriction list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cor_outgoing))
- `dtmf_relay_rtp_nte` (Boolean) RTP Named Telephone Event RFC 2833
- `dtmf_relay_sip_kpml` (Boolean) DTMF Relay via KPML messages
- `dtmf_relay_sip_notify` (Boolean) DTMF Relay via SIP NOTIFY messages
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `id_network_address` (String) IPv4 Address
- `id_network_mask` (String) IPv4 Address Mask
- `translation_profile_incoming` (String) Translation Profile for incoming call leg
- `translation_profile_outgoing` (String) Translation Profile for outgoing call leg
- `voice_class_codec` (String) Set Global Codec parameters
- `voice_class_srtp_crypto` (String) Associates an SRTP cipher list with this pool

<a id="nestedatt--cor_incoming"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cor_incoming`

Read-Only:

- `hyphen` (String) number range
- `id` (String) corlist tag
- `lowerbound` (String) cor list matched number or lower bound number
- `name` (String) cor list name
- `upperbound` (String) cor list matched number or lower bound number

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) cor list tag
- `lowerbound` (String) cor list matched number or lower bound number
- `name` (String) cor list name
- `upperbound` (String) cor list matched number or lower bound number
